segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I’ve got the renewal and seat add in front of me. You’re at 40 seats today, and you wanted to move to 58 for the customer ops team, right?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s right. Forty active now, add 18 on March 1. We need everything co-termed to January 31, 2027, same as the current agreement.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. On the pricing sheet, the added seats come in at $80 per seat per month. So total for 58 seats is $4,640 a month, invoiced quarterly. That’s $13,920 per invoice, net 30.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the first invoice would cover March through May, or does it prorate because the old term started in February?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: For the add-on, first invoice is March 1 through May 31. The renewal term itself runs February 1, 2026 through January 31, 2027. The order form shows those as separate line items so finance can see it clearly.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. We also need the PO number on there, PO-44873. Our AP team kicked one back last quarter because it was missing.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, I’ll include PO-44873 on the billing section. Same billing contact, ap@northlakeindustrial.com?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes. And can you confirm training? We’re targeting March 6 for the new supervisors.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Included. Two admin trainings and one end-user session, all remote. I have March 6 at 10 a.m. Central held for the supervisor group, and we can record it.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send the order form over and I’ll route it today. If it’s clean, we can sign by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Sounds good. I’ll send the order form and invoice schedule right after this. No changes to the MSA or support terms, just the renewal dates, seat count, and PO.
